about: Curated stops for the California, Arizona and Nevada legs (missing roads brief 3, 2026-11-22), placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. Started from every stop the region's legs already carried with coordinates and a source, copied as they were (their readings and sources kept; the leg mile, exit and approach fields belong to one leg's drive and are left to the placing tool), then added to for the new legs from operator pages and state lists. lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it. Season: these stops were already offered year round on the map; the new ones say what was read.

truck_access.about: Counts for the stops added in the missing roads pass. Read: OpenStreetMap hgv=yes on the chain's services area, or truck parking tagged beside a rest area. Assumed: a state rest area on a numbered highway that carries tractor-trailers, with no truck parking tagged. Carried: stops the region's legs already had, copied with their own sources.
